metadata.question: Through the months of December 2018 and January 2019, did sourthern African countries (Namibia, Botswana, Lesotho) recieve less rain than the long-term average for the same two-month period from 2000 to 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use CHIRPS precipitation data (UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/PENTAD or UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY) for precipitation analysis. Need to compare December 2018 + January 2019 vs long-term average for same period (2000-2019). 2. Masking strategy: CHIRPS is pre-processed precipitation data, no cloud masking needed. 3. Logic: - Calculate average precipitation for target period (Dec 2018 + Jan 2019) - Calculate long-term average for same Dec-Jan period across 2000-2019 - Compare if target < long-term average - Need to handle data availability checks and valid pixel counts Steps: - Define region (Namibia, Botswana, Lesotho) - Get target period: Dec 2018 + Jan 2019 - Get baseline periods: Dec+Jan for each year 2000-2019 - Calculate averages and compare - Validate data availability and pixel counts ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define region - southern African countries const countries = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017'); const namibia = countries.filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Namibia')); const botswana = countries.filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Botswana')); const lesotho = countries.filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Lesotho')); const region = namibia.merge(botswana).merge(lesotho); // 2. Load CHIRPS precipitation data const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/PENTAD'); // 3. Target period: Dec 2018 + Jan 2019 const targetPeriod = chirps .filterDate('2018-12-01', '2019-02-01') .select('precipitation'); // Check data availability const targetCount = targetPeriod.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Target period images: ${targetCount}`); if (targetCount === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 4. Calculate target period average const targetSum = targetPeriod.sum(); const targetMean = targetSum.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation'); // 5. Long-term baseline: Dec+Jan for each year 2000-2019 const baselineData = []; for (let year = 2000; year <= 2019; year++) { const decJanPeriod = chirps .filterDate(`${year}-12-01`, `${year+1}-02-01`) .select('precipitation'); const periodCount = decJanPeriod.size().getInfo(); if (periodCount > 0) { const periodSum = decJanPeriod.sum(); const periodMean = periodSum.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation'); baselineData.push(periodMean); } } // Check baseline data availability console.log(`Baseline periods with data: ${baselineData.length}/20`); if (baselineData.length === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 6. Calculate long-term average const baselineArray = ee.Array(baselineData); const longTermAvg = baselineArray.reduce(ee.Reducer.mean(), [0]); // 7. Get values and validate const targetVal = targetMean.getInfo(); const baselineVal = longTermAvg.getInfo()[0]; // Check for valid pixels const pixelCount = targetSum.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`Target period avg: ${targetVal?.toFixed(2)} mm`); console.log(`Long-term avg: ${baselineVal?.toFixed(2)} mm`); console.log(`Valid pixels: ${pixelCount}`); // Validation checks if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } if (targetVal === null || targetVal === undefined || baselineVal === null || baselineVal === undefined || isNaN(targetVal) || isNaN(baselineVal)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // 8. Final comparison if (targetVal < baselineVal) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
